fences.name: Mermaid
fences.purpose: Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and other relationship or process diagrams. Its layout does not represent measured geometry.
fences.syntaxGuidance: Start with a Mermaid diagram declaration such as `flowchart LR` or `sequenceDiagram`, then define its nodes and links. Ground labels and connections in what you know.

fences.name: Math (KaTeX)
fences.purpose: Equations and formulas, typeset. Prose can also carry math: write \( ... \) inside a sentence and $$ ... $$ for an equation on its own line; both are typeset the same way.
fences.syntaxGuidance: LaTeX math-mode only (KaTeX): no document preamble, no \begin{document}. Use aligned or cases environments for several lines. Prefer \( ... \) to $ ... $ for inline math; a single $ pair is read as math only when it hugs its content, as in $x^2$.
